name: aem-contact-sheet
description: Adobe App Builder extension for AEM Assets View and Content Hub to generate customizable PDF Contact Sheets.

scripts.build:exchange: rm -rf .parcel-cache dist && CONTACTSHEET_INTERNAL_FEATURES=false npx aio app build && node scripts/check-exchange.js
scripts.pack:exchange: npx aio app use aemcontactsheets-393012-Production.json --merge --no-input && npm run build:exchange && npx aio app pack && node scripts/check-exchange.js
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:demo:stage && npm run deploy:demo && npm run deploy:exchange:stage && npm run deploy:exchange
